text:
Lina (partnerships): quick heads up — EdgeCo signed LOI; need to finalize redistribution + marketplace bundle terms before next Wed. Can legal + product chime in? cc @Sam @Raj :eyes:
Sam (legal): thanks — quick list of legal hotspots: export control (EAR/ITAR), geo-blocking rights, redistribution license (non-exclusive by default), attribution, model fingerprinting/provenance. Anything else we should add?
Raj (product): two technical asks: 1) packaged quantized artifacts for on-prem vs hosted variants; 2) compatibility matrix for HW partners (A100, 4xT4, ARM edge). Need exact file formats.
Maria (solutions): agree on packaging. We want runnable docker + delta weights + manifest.json including tokenizer spec. propose manifest keys below.
Maria (solutions): ```
{
  "model_version": "string",
  "artifact_type": "docker|tar.gz",
  "quantization": "int8|int4|fp16",
  "tokenizer": "huggingface/xx-tokenizer",
  "checksums": { "weights": "sha256", "docker": "sha256" }
}
```
Sam (legal): for licensing, i'll draft a "Marketplace Redistribution Addendum" with sections: scope, permitted uses, export compliance, geographic restrictions, liability, termination, attribution. will post a short template.
Lina (partnerships): timeline proposal: draft by Fri EOD, legal review Mon, GH staging + CI by Tue, embargo until joint statement Wed EOD. is that tight? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Raj (product): tight but doable. one blocker: HW vendor SIs need integration tests. @Nate can we reuse the Orchestrate test harness we used for Sienna?
Nate (eng-partner): yes — we have a lightweight harness (orchestrate-lite). need EdgeCo to supply quantized model + sample prompts. also confirm license allows sharing of test vectors between partners.
EdgeCo (partner): hey all :wave: we can provide a quantized Llama-3-variant (int8), sample prompts, and a small eval set. we require geoblock for EU + CN and want co-branding on launch.
Sam (legal): geoblock is ok with documented rationale. co-branding requires marketing signoff and a brief MOA. i'll add placeholders in the addendum.
Maria (solutions): packaging checklist (short): manifest.json, docker image, weights tarball, provenance.md, sample_prompts.json. example manifest snippet:```
{
  "model_version": "3.1-edgeco-q8",
  "quantization": "int8",
  "checksum_weights": "sha256:abcd...",
  "sample_prompts_path": "samples/prompts.json",
  "provenance_url": "https://edgeco.example/provenance/3.1"
}
```
Lina (partnerships): :thumbsup: action items — Sam: draft addendum; Maria: formalize manifest spec; Raj + Nate: define CI steps and integration tests; EdgeCo: upload artifacts to staging S3 (presigned link). deadline Tue 12pm PT. any objections?
Raj (product): no objections. add rollback plan if marketplace rejects artifact: immediate de-listing + revert to prior model_id.
Sam (legal): noted — will include de-listing clause and escrow language for weights if needed.
deploy-bot: staging-bucket created: s3://redwood-partners/edgeco/1767777777/ — presign link to follow.
Lina (partnerships): thanks. i'll create GH folder redwood/partners/edgeco-onboard and ping once drafts are in. quick sync Mon 9am PT to finalize?
EdgeCo (partner): 9am PT works for us — thanks everyone :raised_hands:
Maria (solutions): one more ask — please include a small CI test that runs a smoke generation and checks tokenization parity across platforms (python + c++ runtimes).
Nate (eng-partner): will add smoke job to orchestrate-lite. will document expected exit codes and logs.
Sam (legal): i'll post the initial addendum draft in the GH folder by Fri EOD and drop a summary here.
Lina (partnerships): perfect. closing the loop: everyone, please update the GH MR with PR checklist items (manifest, addendum, CI) before Tue 12pm PT.
Raj (product): noted. i'll also flag the SI partners that need heads-up (HWCo, SixtyOne SI).
EdgeCo (partner): we'll start packaging and aim to upload this week. thanks!
